# note author

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:noteAuthor`](gmeow-noteAuthor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/noteAuthor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

The agent who authored a note — the flat 80% shortcut. Non-functional: a note may have multiple co-authors. Promote to a reified [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) or [prov:wasAttributedTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo) when the authorship act itself must carry period, confidence, or standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
